selection_policy: Retrospective evaluator comparison by mechanism, trigger, invariant, and behavioral context; not lexical similarity.

candidates.shared_mechanism: Implicit locale-dependent text decoding replaced by explicit UTF-8.
candidates.why_transfer_is_plausible: Both involve real file I/O with non-ASCII data; the historical fix and regression directly expose the explicit-encoding invariant.
leakage_risks: Do not expose target Chinese regression, target diff, or target changed-file metadata to generation.

candidates.shared_mechanism: Primary explicit-encoding transfer plus a partial file-output-path analogue.
candidates.why_transfer_is_plausible: The first case provides the mechanism signal; the second is in the same target project and reinforces testing public path output while remaining a distractor/weak analogue.
leakage_risks: The PySnooper project identity is visible through ordinary source context; the target bug ID and hidden test remain evaluator-only.

candidates.shared_mechanism: Mixed historical pool with one strong, one partial, and four unrelated cases.
candidates.why_transfer_is_plausible: Contains a transferable case but introduces substantial distraction and was the original Exp1 selection.
leakage_risks: History dilution can be mistaken for lack of transfer.

chosen_candidate.reason: Smallest two-case subset satisfying the requested transfer-feasibility design: one strong mechanism match and one partial same-domain analogue, with exact equality of B/C history.
